title: Senior Engineer, Edge Systems Architecture
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Join Micron Technology’s MCBU (Mobile & Client Business Unit) Systems Lab, where we focus on improving the performance and power efficiency of memory and storage devices for Edge platforms. As a Senior Engineer, Edge Systems Architecture, you will contribute significantly to crafting the future of our next-generation Memory/Storage solutions for Mobile and Client Customers. Here, you will work with innovative technologies and collaborate with a team of skilled professionals.

**Responsibilities**

  

* Determine architectural needs of Memory/Storage Systems based on a competitive market analysis for Mobile and Client platforms.
* Innovate new solutions to complex system-level problems by collaborating closely with Engineering and Product Management teams, with both software and hardware expertise.
* Develop, evaluate, and optimize new memory/storage architectures to improve cost, performance, and power efficiency of Mobile and Client products.
* Define and measure cost, performance, and power metrics for Edge platforms, supported by detailed analysis.
* Understand and improve the architecture of Memory/Storage Controllers for efficient performance.
* Evaluate and demonstrate architecture trade-offs impacting memory/storage subsystem performance.
* Identify and implement AI-enabled opportunities to automate workflows, improve efficiency, and accelerate decision-making processes.
* Develop reusable AI-assisted workflows for benchmark data processing, performance profiling, root-cause analysis, reporting, and technical insight generation.
* Integrate AI capabilities with existing tools, scripts, simulation environments, and validation processes while ensuring data security and result traceability.
* Enable responsible AI adoption by validating outputs, documenting methodologies, sharing standard processes, and measuring improvements in efficiency, quality, and time to insight.

**Requirements**

  

* BS, MS, or PhD or equivalent experience in Electrical/Computer Engineering or Computer Science.
* Proven experience in DRAM/NAND IPs, SoC/IP Development, or Systems Architecture & Analysis for Client/Server/Mobile SoCs.
* Experience working with CPU, GPU, Image Processor, AI Processors, DDR, or systems development.
* Experience in Client/Server/Mobile SoC or Memory Chip build or Systems development.
* Expertise in benchmark (Power, Performance, Thermal) analysis and proficiency in various profiling tools.
* Strong knowledge of Computer and Memory/Storage Architecture.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to articulate results clearly.
* Positive relationship skills and cross-functional collaboration.
* Self-motivated with significant problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in applying AI/ML concepts and tools to system architecture, performance analysis, and design-space exploration.
* Experience evaluating AI workloads across CPU, GPU, NPU/AI accelerators, memory, and storage subsystems.
* Strong knowledge of generative AI and AI-supported engineering tools.
* Ability to assess emerging AI models and workloads and translate their requirements into architecture recommendations.

**Preferred Skills**

  

* 5+ years of Mobile Platform SW or HW knowledge.
* Strong understanding of DRAM, NAND, and other memory/storage devices.
* Strong knowledge of DDR or LPDDR 5/5x, PCIe, and NVMe.
* Exposure to Custom HW platform development.

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all*. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.  
  
To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.  
  
To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport\_india@micron.com

Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.

Your leadership will be demonstrated in your work, to your customers, and within your teams.

* Communicate complex technical and business concepts effectively to customers and stakeholders.
* Serve as a trusted advisor for resolving customer business and technical challenges.
* Analyze, define, and solve complex problems through structured decision-making.
* Collect, evaluate, and integrate information from multiple sources to support timely business decisions.
* Improve service effectiveness, operational efficiency, and delivery through technology and best-practice methodologies.
* Design, develop, integrate, and deliver highly scalable distributed software solutions.
* Drive the continuous evolution and enhancement of software products and platforms.
* Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, and partner teams.
* Develop solutions and functionality that address customer and business requirements.
* Participate in and support the Agile software development lifecycle.
* Groom and refine features and user stories to ensure delivery readiness.
* Estimate effort, identify technical risks, and manage project dependencies.
* Communicate risks, dependencies, and technical considerations to project stakeholders.
* Ensure high-quality feature delivery within established timelines.
* Drive the remediation of technical debt and security vulnerabilities.
* Maintain and upgrade third-party components to ensure product stability, security, and compliance.
* Mentor and coach engineers on software development best practices.
* Guide teams in designing and implementing secure, scalable, and highly available distributed systems.
* Promote engineering excellence through technical leadership and knowledge sharing.
Contribute to the innovation, growth, and success of software products and solutions.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

• Lead functional design and implementation of Oracle EPM Cloud solutions supporting Fleet Procurement and Fleet Accounting processes.

• 15+ years of overall experience in financial systems with 7+ years of hands-on Oracle EPM Cloud experience

• Configure and support FCCS and EPBCS to enable fleet financial consolidation, planning, forecasting, and management reporting.

• Partner with Fleet Accounting, Finance, and FP&A teams to define future-state planning and consolidation models aligned with Oracle Fusion Financials.

• Design and implement integration flows between Oracle Fusion ERP (GL, FAH, AP, AR) and Oracle EPM Cloud using standard adapters, data management, and integration tools.

• Define metadata structures including dimensions, hierarchies, account mappings, cost centers, intercompany, and fleet-specific reporting attribute

• Support design of fleet cost allocation models, capitalization tracking, depreciation analysis, and financial performance reporting in EPM.

• Lead data validation, reconciliation, and variance analysis between Oracle Fusion ERP and Oracle EPM Cloud.

• Collaborate with Data Migration and Technical teams to support initial loads, incremental data refreshes, and reconciliation processes.

• Support SIT, UAT, and parallel close activities to validate EPM outputs against ERP financial results.

• Develop and validate EPM reports, dashboards, Smart View templates, and management reporting artifacts.

• Support planning cycles including budget, forecast, and scenario modeling related to fleet procurement, utilization, and lifecycle costs.

• Provide functional guidance during cutover, deployment, and post-go-live hypercare for EPM components.

• Work closely with PMO, Solution Architects, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment between EPM design and overall program objectives.

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

  

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or related field.

• Strong functional expertise in FCCS and EPBCS, including consolidation, planning, forecasting, and financial reporting.

• Solid understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials including GL, FAH, AP, AR, and how ERP data feeds EPM.Oracle EPM Functional Consultant

• Experience designing EPM solutions for large-scale ERP transformation programs with multi-region deployments.

• Strong knowledge of financial close, consolidation, intercompany eliminations, and management reporting.

• Experience integrating Oracle EPM Cloud with Oracle Fusion ERP using standard integration frameworks.

• Hands-on experience with Smart View, EPM reporting, and data reconciliation techniques.

• Strong analytical skills with ability to translate fleet-related financial data into actionable insights.

• Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.Oracle Financial Consolidation and Close Cloud (FCCS)Implementation Certification, Oracle Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud(EPBCS) Implementation Certification, Oracle EPM Cloud Data Management Certification

  
  
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Member Technical
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**DevOps Senior member Technical -** **Role Overview**

Supports the design and maintenance of enterprise systems by preparing test data, analyzing results, troubleshooting problems and communicating issues back to development. The DevOps approach to software development requires frequent, incremental changes to code versions, resulting in frequent deployment and testing regimens. Develops, monitors and maintain procedures and service level needs while providing user support. Automation engineers design, program, simulate and test automated machinery and processes in order to complete exact tasks.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, monitor, and maintain CI/CD pipelines and supporting infrastructure.
* Support enterprise systems by preparing and executing test scenarios, analyzing outcomes, and identifying areas for improvement.
* Collaborate with development teams to implement DevOps best practices and streamline software delivery processes.
* Automate operational and deployment tasks using scripting and automation tools.
* Manage and support CI/CD platforms, source control repositories, and artifact management systems.
* Monitor system health, availability, and performance of DevOps tools and services.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and automation workflows.
* Maintain operational procedures, service-level requirements, and technical documentation.
* Provide end-user and application support as required.
* Design, program, simulate, test, and optimize automated processes to improve operational efficiency and reliability.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3 to 6 years of experience working with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as **Jenkins, GitLab, Chef, and Artifactory**.
* Strong proficiency in scripting and automation using **Bash, Python, and Groovy**.
* Hands-on experience implementing and maintaining **Continuous Integration (CI)** and **Continuous Deployment (CD)** solutions following industry best practices.
* Experience with **Git-based version control systems** and artifact repository management.
* Ability to monitor, maintain, and ensure high availability of DevOps platforms and services.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills related to deployment and automation environments.
* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Functional Knowledge**

* Demonstrates a solid understanding of DevOps concepts, procedures, and methodologies within the discipline.
* Applies established principles and processes while maintaining a working knowledge of related technical areas.

**Business Expertise**

* Understands key business objectives and operational drivers.
* Applies business knowledge to effectively support team goals and deliver quality outcomes.

**Leadership**

* Functions as an individual contributor with no direct supervisory responsibilities.
* Provides informal mentoring, guidance, and knowledge sharing to new team members.

**Problem Solving**

* Resolves a variety of routine to moderately complex technical issues.
* Evaluates potential solutions using technical expertise, standard procedures, and established practices.
* Works with moderate supervision while exercising sound judgment in decision-making.

**Impact**

* Contributes to the quality and reliability of team deliverables.
* Works within established policies, standards, and operational guidelines to support organizational objectives.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Communicates technical concepts and complex information clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Builds productive working relationships across teams and collaborates effectively in a dynamic environment.

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. title: Staff Software Development Engineer - Yocto / Embedded Linux
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Staff Software Development Engineer - Yocto / Embedded Linux**

**THE ROLE:**

AMD is seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer to join our Embedded System Software team, building the Yocto-based build infrastructure and board support software that enable AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGAs. You will own the layers, distributions, and toolchains that turn new AMD silicon into a buildable, supportable software platform for Linux, OpenBMC, and real-time workloads.

Working alongside AMD silicon architects, hardware designers, kernel and firmware teams, and the Yocto and OpenEmbedded communities, you will take new silicon from first power-on to a supportable, upstreamable platform, and build the images, SDKs, and reference designs customers develop against.

**THE PERSON:**

The ideal candidate is passionate about embedded Linux and build systems, and enjoys solving complex system-level challenges that span hardware and software boundaries. You possess strong software engineering fundamentals, deep expertise in Yocto and board support package development, and a proven ability to drive features from concept through silicon bring-up and into production.

You are comfortable across the full stack, from a device tree node to a released SDK, and collaborate effectively with architects and engineering teams across AMD.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Yocto Build Infrastructure:** Design and maintain the Yocto and OpenEmbedded layers that enable new AMD silicon — SoC family definitions, machine configurations, tunes, and layer architecture across BSP and distro layers.
* **Kernel, Bootloader and Boot Image Integration:** Integrate recipes for the Linux kernel, U-Boot, TF-A, and platform firmware, and build the boot artifact pipeline — device tree packaging, flash layout, signing, secure boot, and golden-image recovery.
* **Multi-Domain Builds and SDKs:** Define multiconfig builds that produce Linux, RTOS, firmware, and programmable logic artifacts together, and deliver the SDKs and toolchains teams develop against.
* **Adaptive SoC and Programmable Logic:** Integrate programmable logic into the software stack, including bitstream packaging, device tree overlays, and enabling PL interfaces from Linux.
* **Silicon and Board Bring-Up:** Participate in new silicon and board bring-up from first power-on, holding the integrated image and driving issues to root cause with hardware and firmware teams.
* **CI, Release and Technical Leadership:** Maintain QEMU-based virtual platforms and continuous integration, deliver release artifacts and software bills of materials, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to architecture reviews.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Deep hands-on experience with the **Yocto Project, OpenEmbedded, and BitBake** — authoring recipes, bbappends, and classes, building BSP and distro layers, SDK generation, and diagnosing complex build failures.
* Strong **embedded Linux** and board support package background: the Linux kernel from a platform integration standpoint, device trees, kernel configuration and fragments, driver enablement, and bootloaders and early firmware such as **U-Boot and TF-A**.
* Familiarity with **BMC products and the platform management domain**, and interfaces such as I2C, SPI, eSPI, and PECI.
* Strong programming skills in **C and C++**, and proficiency in Python or shell scripting for build and automation work.
* Experience debugging complex system-level issues spanning build systems, operating systems, drivers, bootloaders, and firmware, and familiarity with **Git and CI/CD** workflows.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience with **AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGA technologies**, including AMD Vivado™ or Vitis™ and hardware/software co-design.
* **Zephyr or another embedded RTOS**, and **RISC-V** or other non-x86 architectures, including board enablement and toolchain integration.
* Inter-processor communication frameworks such as **OpenAMP** in heterogeneous multi-core systems.
* Experience with **OpenBMC** or a comparable BMC software stack and its integration into a Yocto distribution.
* **QEMU** or comparable virtual platforms for pre-silicon development and continuous integration.
* Experience developing **reference designs or proof-of-concept solutions**, and release engineering at scale including SBOM and CVE triage.
* Contributions to the Yocto Project, OpenEmbedded, or Linux open-source projects, with strong analytical and communication skills and demonstrated technical leadership.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

Bachelor's degree + 8 years of experience or Master's degree + 6 years of experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

title: Staff AI Engineer
description:
**About Meeru AI**

Meeru AI is building an AI-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. We connect to enterprise financial systems — ERPs, CRMs, billing platforms, HRIS — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for CFOs, controllers, and FP&A leaders.

We deploy on customer terms — \*\*SaaS multi-tenant, SaaS single-tenant, and on-premises\*\* — across \*\*AWS, Azure, and GCP\*\*. Our customers are Fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance.

**The Role**

We are looking for a \*\*Staff AI Engineer\*\* to own the AI and intelligence layer — and the discipline that keeps it honest. Our output sits adjacent to externally reported financials, so "sounds plausible" is not good enough: everything the AI produces must be grounded in, and traceable to, verified data.

You own the machine-learning models that learn each customer's patterns, the LLM and agentic systems that produce grounded natural-language output, and the rigor that keeps that output faithful. You build per-customer models without leaking the very signal they're meant to detect, and you set a high bar for evaluation and grounding across the layer.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You set technical direction for the AI layer, partner closely with the evaluation engineer to make quality measurable, and turn user feedback into durable improvements.

**What makes this role different**

* Grounding is a hard requirement no fabricated or unsupported output, ever. Faithfulness is a gate, not a tuning goal
* Clear separation of concerns ML surfaces and prioritizes; generated text only states what is supported by verified data or confirmed by a human
* Per-customer intelligence models that learn each business's behavior, with strict anti-leakage discipline
* Deploys in customer clouds including managed LLMs in-VPC, so customer data never leaves their environment

  
**Requirements**  

* **Staff-level applied ML/AI experience in production.** You have shipped and owned real ML and AI systems used by customers, and you have set technical direction for others, not only built prototypes.
* **Strong classical machine learning.** Hands-on depth in time-series modeling, anomaly and outlier detection, and gradient-boosted models such as LightGBM or XGBoost, using Python, scikit-learn and pandas or Polars.
* **Modern LLM and agent patterns.** You have built retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and structured (schema-validated) output, and orchestrated them with LangGraph or a similar framework.
* **Rigor on evaluation, grounding and hallucination control.** You know how to measure whether an LLM's output is faithful to its source data, and you have built guardrails that stop unsupported statements from reaching users.
* **Discipline around data leakage and honest evaluation.** You design features, splits and validation so models are never trained or scored on information they would not have in real use.
* **Clear thinking about what ML can and cannot claim.** You can explain to non-ML colleagues where a model's output is evidence and where it is only a signal, and why that line matters when results sit next to reported financials.
* **Real software engineering.** You write tested, production-grade Python services, are comfortable with SQL against warehouses like Snowflake or PostgreSQL, and have shipped containerized software.
* **Technical leadership.** You mentor engineers and work closely with backend, data, product and evaluation colleagues to turn feedback into lasting improvements.

Nice-to-haves

* **Finance or accounting domain experience.** Familiarity with ERP, billing or FP&A data and the audit expectations around it.
* **Feature-attribution literacy.** Experience with tools like SHAP, and a clear view of where attribution explanations break down.
* **Human-in-the-loop systems.** You have designed review, confirmation or correction workflows and fed them back into models.
* **Managed LLMs inside customer clouds.** Experience running AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or Azure OpenAI inside a customer's VPC so their data never leaves their environment.
* **Sparse and zero-inflated data.** Experience modeling rare events or data that is mostly zeros.
* **Multi-deployment enterprise software.** Exposure to products shipped as multi-tenant SaaS, single-tenant SaaS and on-premises across AWS, Azure and GCP.

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Consultant Specialist you’ll design, develop and deploy machine learning and AI solutions aligned to business objectives. The role focuses on taking applied AI from idea to production - shaping use cases, building models and integrating them into services and data pipelines. You’ll work across cross-functional teams to translate business problems into scalable solutions that improve customer and user experiences. Success means reliable models in production with clear performance metrics, monitoring and continuous improvement in place. You’ll also help strengthen engineering standards by contributing to AI architecture, experimentation and software engineering practices.

In this role, you will:

* Design, develop and deploy machine learning and AI solutions aligned to business objectives
* Build and optimise models across NLP, computer vision, predictive analytics, recommendation systems and LLM-powered applications
* Partner with cross-functional teams to identify high-impact use cases and translate business needs into scalable AI solutions
* Develop production-ready APIs, services and data pipelines to integrate AI capabilities into existing systems
* Evaluate model performance, reliability and business impact using appropriate metrics and experimentation frameworks
* Embed MLOps practices for deployment, monitoring, retraining, governance and continuous improvement
* Track emerging AI trends and recommend practical adoption strategies for the organisation
* Mentor engineers and strengthen best practices in AI architecture, experimentation and software engineering

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:

* 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 2–3 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML.
* Apply strong Python capability and experience with AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow and scikit-learn
* Demonstrate a solid grounding in machine learning fundamentals, feature engineering, model evaluation and experimentation
* Build and deploy models on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP
* Apply data engineering fundamentals including SQL and building scalable data pipelines
* Develop applied solutions using LLMs, generative AI, NLP or related approaches
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders to shape requirements and coordinate cross-functional delivery

Building Production-Grade AI

If you want to take applied AI work from concept to real-world outcomes this role offers the scope to do it at scale. You’ll build models and services that support business priorities and improve customer and user experiences. You’ll also help embed strong engineering and MLOps practices so solutions stay reliable over time. If that work sounds like a good fit we’d welcome your application.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

www.hsbc.com/careers

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by – HSBC Software Development India

title: Senior Engineer, Virtualization
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***

**AHEAD is searching for a Senior Virtualization Engineer to be a part of our Managed Services team.** Candidates will be primarily responsible for the overall health, stability, security, performance, and lifecycle management of virtualization and compute platforms in our managed services customer environments. Candidates will serve as a senior member of the Managed Services Virtualization team, providing tier 3 technical leadership for virtualization technologies, complex incidents, platform improvements, and customer outcomes. The role participates in 24x7 operations and an on-call rotation. The ideal candidate should be customer focused, an effective communicator, self-initiating, accountable, and able to perform most tasks without direct oversight.

### **Principle Duties and Responsibilities**

Provide enterprise-level operational support for incident, problem, change, request, and event-management activities  

Lead complex and escalated virtualization incidents, including high-risk, recurring, cross-domain, vendor-dependent, and platform-impacting issues  
* Provide technical leadership during P1 incidents by assessing impact, coordinating technical actions, documenting risks and decisions, and driving resolution through closure

* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for virtualization and compute technologies, addressing technical events and requests needing additional resources or urgent attention

Assess customer environments for performance, capacity, configuration, design, resilience, security, and supportability issues; propose and implement resolutions  

* Provide architectural oversight and validate that proposed changes, designs, and remediation plans align with vendor-supported practices, client standards, capacity, resiliency, security, and service scope

* Work across networking, storage, operating-system, security, monitoring, automation, and application teams to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues

Work with vendors and hardware partners to resolve virtualization and compute issues, coordinate escalations, and implement supported resolutions  

* Own or contribute to problem-management records, corrective actions, preventive actions, post-incident reviews, and technical root-cause analyses for recurring or systemic issues

Lead or support platform lifecycle activities, including upgrade readiness, compatibility validation, capacity planning, end-of-support and end-of-life assessments, patch planning, firmware coordination, and VCF lifecycle management  

Maintain accurate client architecture, access, configuration, monitoring, hardware, firmware, inventory, and maintenance documentation. Reconcile documentation against authoritative platform, CMDB, monitoring, and inventory sources  
* Ensure that clients' infrastructure is healthy, stable, secure, documented, and configured with accepted technical best practices

Perform recurring operational-risk reviews and identify opportunities to improve platform stability, supportability, monitoring coverage, security posture, automation, and service consistency  

Support annual architecture, capacity, lifecycle, and standard-operating-procedure reviews, and provide technical inputs for quarterly business reviews or other strategic client reviews  
Own the technical execution of assigned client onboarding and offboarding activities, including access validation, monitoring coverage, vendor access, initial documentation, known-issue identification, and EoS/EoL review  
* Provide clear technical context, risk, impact, dependencies, recommended actions, and next steps to Client Success Managers and customer technical contacts. Business-impacting or scope-related customer communications should be coordinated through the appropriate Client Success Manager

* Participate in 24x7 operations and the on-call rotation, including major incidents and planned maintenance activities as scheduled

Complete training and certification as assigned to further skills and knowledge  

* Mentor L2 engineers, improve escalation quality, review technical work when assigned, and contribute to standards, runbooks, knowledge articles, training, and continuous-improvement initiatives

### **Qualifications/ Technology Experience**

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Unique education, specialized experience, skills, knowledge, training, or certification may be substituted)  

* 10+ yrs of experience with virtualization technologies and enterprise infrastructure operations
* + Experience with VMware vSphere/VVF required
  + Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) required
  + Experience with Nutanix AHV required
  + Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V preferred
  Experience with Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization, including virtual-machine lifecycle management, networking, storage integration, and operational troubleshooting
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) deployment, configuration, lifecycle management, and operational support
* + Proficiency in VCF lifecycle management, including automated deployment, patching, and upgrades using SDDC Manager
  + Experience with VCF workload domains, including VI workload domains and NSX-T network virtualization
  + Knowledge of VCF validated designs and reference architectures for hybrid-cloud implementations
  + Experience with VCF integration with public-cloud services (VMware Cloud on AWS, Azure VMware Solution, Google Cloud VMware Engine) preferred
  + Experience with VCF's automated deployment and configuration of vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and vRealize Suite or Aria components
  Demonstrated ability to manage converged infrastructure through VCF's unified platform spanning compute, storage, networking, and security
10+ yrs of experience with operational administration of enterprise IT systems  
10+ yrs of experience with performance and infrastructure monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, Elastic, or comparable platforms)  
5+ yrs of experience with an enterprise ITSM system. ServiceNow preferred  
* Experience with Cisco UCS and Dell hardware systems required
Familiarity with Dell PowerFlex/PowerStore/VxRail preferred  
* Operating System skills with Windows and Linux preferred
Understanding of PowerShell and PowerCLI with ability to create and utilize scripts for administration, troubleshooting, reporting, and automation required  
Managed Services or consulting experience required  
VMware Certified Professional certification required; VMware Certified Advanced Professional certification preferred  
* ITILv4 certification preferred

### **Qualifications: Soft Skills**

Advanced technical troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities  

* Approach projects, changes, and problems with a “security first” mindset

Superior customer service and training skills  

* Possess a strong sense of urgency and ability to set priorities during normal operations and high-impact events

Ability to work without direct supervision and make sound technical decisions  

Team-oriented collaborator willing to share knowledge and experience  
Ability to communicate technical risk, business impact, dependencies, decisions, and recommended actions clearly to engineers, managers, CSMs, vendors, and customer technical stakeholders  
Ability to remain accountable for coordination and follow-through until the next owner formally accepts an escalation  
* Ability to balance customer requests with platform capacity, resiliency, security, contractual scope, change control, and operational risk

Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills and ability to build and maintain collaborative and positive working relationships at all levels  

Ability to effectively interact with all levels of business via phone, written communication, and in person  
Skilled in achieving results in a customer centric environment  
* Self-motivated, able to work in a fast-paced 24x7 managed-services environment

**Why AHEAD:**

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

**India Employment Benefits include:**

**Comprehensive health insurance** coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents

**Paid time off and company holidays**, along with additional leave benefits as per policy

**Flexible work arrangements**, supporting work-life balance

**Learning and development opportunities** to support continuous growth and upskilling

**Employee wellness initiatives** and programs focused on physical and mental well-being

**Retirement and statutory benefits** in line with India regulations

**Inclusive and people-first culture**, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Engineering Manager – AI CoE
description:
**Senior Engineering Manager** **– AI** **CoE**

**About Redwood**

Redwood Software helps the world's largest enterprises automate mission-critical business processes. Our platforms support complex enterprise workloads across ERP systems, business applications, cloud infrastructure, and on-premises environments.

Redwood is building reusable AI infrastructure, agentic capabilities, developer tools, and platform services that enable enterprise-ready AI features across its product portfolio.

**Role Mission**

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead the engineering team responsible for delivering Redwood's shared AI platform and agentic capabilities.

You will translate the AI strategy into an executable engineering roadmap, build a high-performing team, and ensure the delivery of secure, scalable, observable, and commercially valuable AI systems. The role requires sufficient technical depth to guide architecture and challenge engineering decisions while remaining accountable for people's leadership, execution, team health, and delivery outcomes.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead one or more engineering teams responsible for AI platform services, agentic capabilities, developer tools, and product integrations.
* Translate business and product priorities into a clear engineering roadmap, delivery plan, and team-level objectives.
* Recruit, onboard, manage, and retain engineers with the skills required to build production-grade AI and agentic systems.
* Establish clear ownership, performance expectations, decision-making responsibilities, and development plans across the team.
* Drive predictable execution through effective planning, dependency management, risk identification, and operational readiness.
* Partner with senior individual contributors to guide architecture and technical direction without becoming a bottleneck for engineering decisions.
* Ensure consistent engineering practices across AI evaluation, observability, model governance, security, reliability, performance, and cost management.
* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, Data, Legal, and product engineering teams to deliver enterprise-ready AI capabilities.
* Balance shared platform investments with customer-facing requirements and immediate product priorities.
* Monitor delivery, quality, platform adoption, incidents, operational performance, and engineering effectiveness.
* Establish an engineering culture focused on ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer outcomes.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance discussions, and career development planning.
* Communicate engineering progress, risks, dependencies, and investment requirements to senior stakeholders.
* Maintain sufficient technical involvement to understand architectural risks, challenge decisions, and support critical engineering outcomes.
  

**Scope and Expected Impact**

  

* Own engineering outcomes for a critical AI platform domain or multiple related engineering teams.
* Convert broad strategic priorities into measurable plans, milestones, and delivery commitments.
* Make organizational, staffing, prioritization, and delivery decisions with medium- to long-term impact.
* Create alignment across senior engineers, Product, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders.
* Improve delivery predictability, platform adoption, engineering quality, and operational reliability.
* Scale the organization through clear ownership, repeatable engineering practices, and strong technical leadership.
* Ensure the team can deliver effectively without depending excessively on any single individual.

  

**Must Have Qualifications**

  

* 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 4+ years in an engineering people-management or team-leadership role.
* Experience leading one or more engineering teams responsible for complex software products or platform services.
* Demonstrated experience hiring, managing performance, coaching engineers, and supporting career development.
* Track record of delivering enterprise SaaS, cloud, distributed systems, platform, ML, or AI products into production.
* Strong working knowledge of generative AI, agentic architectures, LLM-based applications, orchestration, and production deployment considerations.

* Understanding agent workflows involving tool use, retrieval, enterprise data, APIs, memory, guardrails, and human oversight.

* Experience managing technical roadmaps, delivery risks, dependencies, incidents, quality, and operational performance.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, cloud-native systems, automated testing, CI/CD, security, and observability.
* Ability to guide technical decisions and architecture discussions while empowering senior engineers to own implementation.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical and business trade-offs to senior stakeholders.
* Experience working effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to operate with high autonomy and manage ambiguity in a product or high-scale technology environment.

  

**Strong Plus**

  

* Experience establishing or scaling an AI platform, agentic engineering team, Center of Excellence, or developer platform function.
* Hands-on exposure to LangGraph, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or custom agent orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with AI evaluation platforms, model gateways, vector databases, prompt lifecycle management, or AI observability tools.
* Understanding of responsible AI, model governance, privacy, compliance, and enterprise security requirements.
* Experience in enterprise middleware, workflow orchestration, ERP, automation, or integration platforms.
* Experience balancing greenfield platform development with the modernization of existing enterprise products.
* Experience working in regulated, security-sensitive, or high-availability environments.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  

* Builds a healthy, appropriately staffed engineering team with clear responsibilities and strong technical ownership.
* Delivers AI platform and agentic capabilities predictably while maintaining security, reliability, quality, and cost discipline.
* Creates measurable adoption of shared AI capabilities across Redwood's product engineering teams.
* Establishes clear engineering standards for AI evaluation, observability, governance, and production readiness.
* Improves team effectiveness, delivery predictability, and operational performance.
* Develops capable engineers and reduces organizational dependency on individual contributors.
* Provides senior stakeholders with a clear, evidence-based view of progress, risks, dependencies, and investment requirements.

*If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

  

**THE LEGAL BIT**  
Redwood is an equal opportunity employer. Redwood prohibits unlawful discrimination based on race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), sexual orientation, pregnancy or any other consideration made unlawful by regional or local laws. We also prohibit discrimination based on a perception that anyone has any of those characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics. All such discrimination is unlawful and will have a zero tolerance policy applied to it.

  

Redwood will comply with all local data protection laws, including GDPR when it comes to the handling and processing of personal data. Should you wish for us to remove your personal data from our recruitment database, please email us directly at Privacy@Redwood.com

title: Engineering Analyst, Payments Trust and Safety
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
* 2 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 4 years of experience in the Payments industry, working on risk or fraud management.
* Experience in querying and analyzing large sets of data.
* Strong project and program management skills and experience.
* Working knowledge in one or more of the following areas: statistical analysis and machine learning libraries (e.g., R, Scikit-learn,TensorFlow), programming languages (e.g., Python, C/C++), Large Language Models (LLMs) or Generative AI.
* Demonstrated ability to identify workflow pain points, optimize, automate and scale processes.
* Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever-changing environment.

**About the job**
-----------------

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. title: Senior IT Supervisor - Data
description:

Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. **A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Data Platform & Services organization delivers enterprise data, analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and cloud capabilities that enable scalable, secure, and trusted data solutions across the business. The team is responsible for modernizing data platforms, advancing cloud adoption, and establishing foundational data services that support operational excellence, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
As the Senior IT Supervisor, Data Engineering, you will drive the implementation of foundational data capabilities that support a variety of business functions. You will cultivate strategic partnerships with stakeholders to successfully implement cloud-based technologies that acquire, process, and store data across multiple latency requirements, enabling Data as a Service (DaaS) and Analytics as a Service (AaaS). * Manage delivery plans, dependencies, risks, issues, resource allocation, and governance activities in partnership with program and project stakeholders.

* Implement and scale Agile practices including Scrum and Kanban, driving sprint execution, backlog management, capacity planning, and delivery forecasting.
* Partner with business stakeholders, Product Owners, Architects, and Security teams to align technology solutions with business priorities and enterprise standards.

Drive platform reliability, cost optimization, continuous improvement, incident resolution, and operational performance across enterprise data and cloud environments.  

  

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* 10+ years of IT experience with a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, MCA, MSc or MBA.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Working at Abbott**

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You will also have access to:

  

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit, an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor's degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**About Lingo**

Meet Lingo, a new biosensing technology that provides users a window into their body. Lingo tracks key biomarkers such as glucose, ketones, and lactate to help people make better decisions about their health and nutrition. Biowearable technology will digitize, decentralize and democratize healthcare, enabling consumers to take control of their own health.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

As Staff Platform Engineer at Lingo, you will spend meaningful time building and operating alongside your team, taking ownership of technically complex platform work while also being responsible for the day-to-day allocation of work, tracking and providing feedback to Platform Engineers at the India location. You set the technical standard your team works to, you unblock them when problems are hard, and you make sure they have the clarity, context, and support to do their best work.

Azure is our primary cloud platform. You will bring strong hands-on Azure expertise and apply it across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and SRE practices, while developing your two direct reports to grow in the same disciplines.

**What You'll Work On**

  

* Own the day-to-day work allocation for your team, ensuring engineers have well-scoped, meaningful work that matches their skills and develops their capabilities.
* Support your team through technical challenges, unblocking complex problems and guiding engineers toward solutions rather than solving everything yourself.
* Build, provision, and maintain Lingo's cloud infrastructure on Azure, taking ownership of technically complex or high-risk platform work alongside your team.
* Own and evolve key areas of Lingo's infrastructure-as-code foundation using Terraform or Bicep, including module design, standards, and code review for your team's contributions.
* Design and maintain CI/CD pipeline architecture for Lingo's engineering teams, defining deployment patterns, environment promotion gates, and release automation standards that your team implements and operates.
* Lead from the front on SRE practices, contributing to SLO and SLI definitions, designing alerting and monitoring configurations, and driving post-incident reviews that generate real engineering improvements.
* Build and maintain observability tooling across Lingo's production environment, covering distributed tracing, log pipelines, and metrics collection, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need.
* Partner with product and feature engineering teams to support their deployment needs, onboard them to platform tooling, and reduce friction in the path from development to production.
* Contribute to architecture and design discussions with the Platform Engineer Lead and Senior Manager, providing practical input grounded in your day-to-day operational experience.
* Document infrastructure, runbooks, and operational processes in a way that supports knowledge sharing across Lingo's globally distributed engineering team spanning the US, Spain, and India.
* Identify process, tooling, and reliability improvements within your team's domain and drive them to completion with appropriate prioritization and stakeholder communication.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering with hands-on work in a production environment.
* Strong hands-on Azure expertise, with production experience across Azure compute, networking, storage, identity, and security services.
* Solid infrastructure-as-code skills with Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent, including designing and reviewing reusable modules in a team environment.
* Proven experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent, including deployment automation and environment promotion.
* Working understanding of SRE principles including SLOs, SLIs, alerting strategies, on-call practices, and incident response and post-incident review workflows.
* Experience with observability tooling for monitoring, logging, and distributed tracing in a cloud-native environment.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls including identity and access management, network security configurations, and secrets management.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across a globally distributed engineering team spanning multiple time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Azure-native services such as Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure Security Center in a production context.
* Experience supporting IoT, biosensor, or real-time consumer health data platforms where data reliability and low-latency processing are critical.
* Familiarity with AIOps tooling and AI-driven observability practices, including anomaly detection and automated alerting.
* Background in MLOps infrastructure, including model serving, feature stores, and pipeline orchestration on cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud security and compliance frameworks including HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI in an engineering context.
* Prior experience in a consumer technology company or high-growth digital health environment.

title: Software Engineering- Mulesoft, MTS/SMTS
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

We are looking for a forward-thinking **Software Engineer** to own, administer, and scale our MuleSoft integrations across our Finance systems landscape, supporting mission-critical business processes. In this role, you will serve as the primary process expert for your service area, keeping enterprise APIs running smoothly while working closely with developers, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to support end-to-end Salesforce business processes.

Beyond core administration, you will drive operational efficiency by analyzing support trends, identifying enhancements, and actively redesigning workflows by integrating AI agents alongside human support engineers. * **Communication & Collaboration:** Strong verbal and written communication skills with a track record of collaborating effectively with developers, QA, and business partners.

**Required Skills**

* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Application & Cloud Security Lead
description:
**About the Role:**

11

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Application & Cloud Security Lead will serve as a key security leader within the S&P Global Energy Division BISO team, responsible for coordinating security initiatives across application, cloud, and AI-enabled environments. This role directly supports the protection of applications, data, systems, and reputation by proactively managing cyber risk, strengthening resilience and embedding security into everything we do.

The successful candidate will partner with technology, product, engineering, cloud, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure security is integrated into architecture, delivery, operations, and innovation. The role will focus on security architecture reviews, application security governance, cloud security enforcement, AI security oversight, risk remediation, and alignment with enterprise cybersecurity standards.

This position requires a hands-on security leader who can translate cybersecurity requirements into practical controls, influence engineering teams, guide secure design decisions, and drive measurable improvements in cyber resilience across the Energy Division.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead and coordinate application, cloud, and AI security initiatives across the S&P Global Energy Division in alignment with S&P Global's cyber risk management objectives.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data flows, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions to identify risks and recommend secure design improvements.
* Partner with engineering, product, architecture, cloud, and business teams to embed security requirements into solution design, development, deployment, and operations.
* Enforce application security controls, including secure coding practices, vulnerability remediation, authentication, authorization, secrets management, dependency security, and software supply chain risk management.
* Oversee cloud security control implementation across public cloud environments, including identity and access management, network security, encryption, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration.
* Review and assess AI and machine learning use cases for security risks, including data leakage, prompt injection, model exposure, access control, third-party AI risk, and misuse scenarios.
* Track, prioritize, and drive remediation of application, cloud, and AI security findings, exceptions, and risk acceptances in partnership with accountable technology owners.
* Support cyber risk assessments, compliance reviews, audit requests, and security reporting related to Energy Division applications, cloud services, and AI-enabled platforms.
* Develop and maintain metrics, dashboards, and executive-level reporting to communicate security posture, risk trends, remediation progress, and key security initiatives.
* Serve as a trusted security advisor and liaison between the Energy Division and Enterprise cybersecurity teams, promoting secure-by-design practices and consistent adoption of security standards.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5-8+ years experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on application security, cloud security, security architecture, and/or technology risk management.
* Experience conducting security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data platforms, and enterprise technology solutions.

* Experience with cloud security tools such as CSPM, CWPP, CNAPP, SIEM, vulnerability management platforms, container scanners, and identity governance tools.
* Familiar with AI security concepts such as prompt injection, model access control, sensitive data exposure, model monitoring, adversarial testing, AI red teaming, and third-party AI risk.
* Experience working with public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders including technology, product, risk, compliance, privacy, legal, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to prioritise risks, influence remediation, and drive outcomes in a complex enterprise environment.

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

**About the Role:** Data Security Lead

  

**The Team:** The IP Security team safeguards S&P Global’s proprietary assets—source code, models, datasets, design artifacts, architecture, and know‑how across applications and infrastructure. We set the standards, controls, and guardrails that prevent leakage, misuse, or unauthorized commercialization of intellectual property, and we enable product teams to innovate quickly while staying compliant with enterprise policy and regulatory obligations.

  

**Responsibilities and Impact:** The Data Security Engineering Lead – Intellectual Property (IP) is accountable for designing, implementing, and operating S&P Global’s enterprise capabilities for protecting intellectual property. This role converts the IP security architecture into scalable, resilient engineering solutions that provide deep visibility into where critical data and IP artifacts reside, what type of data they represent, how they are accessed, and how they are utilized across applications and AI systems.

  

The Engineering Lead oversees the day‑to‑day technical execution of IP discovery, classification, access monitoring, and protection controls. The role includes leading a team of engineers and partnering closely with architecture, cloud, data, and AI platform teams to ensure comprehensive and consistent safeguarding of the company’s intellectual property.

  

**What We’re Looking For:**

**Engineering & Platform Implementation**

* Lead the design, deployment, and operation of **data security platforms** supporting discovery, classification, and monitoring
* Implement enterprise-scale **DSPM capabilities** across cloud, on-prem, SaaS, and third-party environments

**Data Discovery & Classification Execution**

* Build and operate pipelines to **identify where data resides** across structured and unstructured sources
* Implement automated **data classification and tagging** aligned with enterprise standards

**Data Sources & Access Monitoring**

* Integrate data security tools with **IAM, cloud services, and data platforms**

**Intellectual Property (IP) Protection Engineering**

* Implement **IP protection mechanisms** , including data watermarking, tagging, fingerprinting, and metadata controls
* Integrate IP protections into data pipelines and AI workflows

**Operational Security & Incident Response**

* Operate and tune detection mechanisms for **data exposure and misuse**
* Support security incident investigations by rapidly identifying impacted data and access paths
* Partner with SOC and IR teams to automate alerts and response workflows
  

**Engineering Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data security engineers
* Establish engineering standards, coding practices, and operational runbooks
* Drive automation to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Data Security Architects, Cloud Security, IAM, Privacy, Legal, and AI teams
* Translate architectural requirements into deployable engineering solutions
* Provide technical input into roadmap planning and platform evaluations
  

**Basic Required Qualifications:**

* Experience with **DSPM platforms** (e.g., Cyera, Wiz DSPM, BigID)

title: Staff AI Engineer
description:
**Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble Health Partners India!**

Ensemble Health Partners - The single solution for a frictionless revenue cycle with the purpose of redefining the possible in healthcare by empowering people to be the difference. Our India Office is an extension of Ensemble’s team and culture designed to augment and enhance our talent and skill base in Revenue Cycle Management in addition to our long-standing presence in technology. As a leading player in the industry, we offer an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration, where your expertise will be valued, and your contributions will make a difference.

**The Opportunity:**

**The Role:**

We are looking for an Applied AI Engineer to build, evaluate, and continuously improve clinical AI agents and supervised ML Models. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, LLM systems, evaluation, model improvement, and deep healthcare workflow understanding.

Your job is to turn frontier model capability into reliable production behavior: agents that read complex medical records, use the right clinical and coding context, call the right tools, produce auditable outputs, and improve from real-world failures.

You will be embedded in hard healthcare problems, clinical documentation integrity, medical coding, denial prevention, appeals, revenue cycle workflows, and payer logic — and will own the loop from problem framing to agent design, evaluation, deployment, trace analysis, and ongoing improvement.

The ideal candidate is a strong engineer who thinks like an applied scientist: rigorous about measurement, comfortable with ambiguity, excited by messy real-world data, and motivated by closing the gap between impressive demos and dependable production systems.

Most AI roles are either too research-heavy or too product-light. This role sits in the middle. You will not only write prompts or run experiments. You will own whether an agent actually works in production. That means understanding the workflow, designing the system, building the evals, inspecting failures, improving the agent, and proving that the improvement matters.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and continuously improve production AI systems for complex healthcare workflows, including documentation, coding, denial management, appeals, and revenue cycle automation.
* Prototype new AI capabilities from 0 to 1, then harden them into reliable, explainable, auditable production systems with clear contracts, monitoring, evidence, and performance gates.
* Build rigorous evaluation and feedback loops using expert review, production logs, model outputs, and benchmarks to measure performance, regressions, reliability, cost, and business impact.
* Own outcomes end to end: understand the workflow, design the system, inspect failures, improve the system, and prove that the improvement matters.
* Set technical direction for a portfolio of projects, review designs, and mentor engineers as a technical lead.
* Partner with research, ML engineering, platform, and product teams on model selection, training, infrastructure, and Productionalization.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Master's or PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field is a plus.

**Industry Experience**

* 5-10 years of Applied Research, ML engineering, research engineering, software engineering, or applied AI experience.
* A track record of shipping and operating production systems, ideally in ambiguous, high-stakes domains.
* Prior experience in healthcare, revenue cycle management, or other regulated industries is a plus, not a requirement.

People First, Last + Always

title: Staff Engineer Photolithography
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a Photolithography Engineer at Micron, you will be responsible to tackle critical lithography scribe challenges for memory devices. In this position, you will be responsible for supporting work for the photolithography team. This includes modeling to support optical simulation related to scribe mark, provide mark design recommendations, identifying root causes for sophisticated problems, and providing simulation training for other photolithography engineers. You will also define and lead projects to address photolithography performance gaps on current and future memory and storage nodes.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Understand the technology challenges with respect to overlay and establish project plans to address them for the N, N+1, and N+2 nodes.
* Work with vendor applications teams to find areas for overlay scribe improvement.
* Drive technical innovation in your area of expertise as a recognized Micron expert in your field.
* Standardize methods and procedures across area, department and/or FABs.
* Define and lead sophisticated, multi-disciplinary projects that are essential to Micron’s photolithography roadmap. Help to craft strategic decisions.
* Work with process development engineers on issues and projects related to photolithography.
* Summarize plans, progress to experimental work, and conclusions in the form of written reports.
* Provide advice and counsel to senior management on technical issues related to overlay scribe.
* Build strong customer relationships to understand customer expectations.
* Integrates AI-assisted tools and insights into daily work to improve efficiency, quality, or effectiveness, exercising sound judgment and complying with organizational standards and legal requirements.
* Contributes to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, testing, and sharing AI-enabled enhancements within one’s scope of work.

Qualifications for this position include:

* Strong understanding of photolithography. Familiarity with semiconductor process integration is a plus.
* Understanding of optics. Understanding of the principals of photolithography and optical metrology.
* Understanding of how lens aberrations, scanner chuck differences, and process variations can affect overlay.
* Understand various alignment and overlay marks. Understand how mark type and design can impact overlay errors. Experience with overlay mark simulation software is a plus.
* Ability to develop and maintain relationships with multi-functional teams and suppliers.
* Strong curiosity about research and development and ability to build production-worthy technologies.
* Strong communication skills (written, verbal and presentation).
* Ability to apply baseline digital fluency and role‑appropriate AI literacy to use AI‑enabled tools responsibly and effectively for research, analysis, content creation, problem‑solving, operational tasks, and achieving business outcomes.
